name: Requirements Analysis
description: Separate what was stated, what was inferred, and what is still unknown.

permissionsRequired.reason: Read a project file that the question depends on.
Read a long document section instead of a lone snippet.
Find the code or docs that the question is about.

validation.rule: Findings separate explicit requirements, inferred requirements, constraints, assumptions, and unresolved questions, and they do not claim implementation.
